confirmation.description: Se enviarán tus ingresos netos, deudas y capital ya asegurado a PuntoSeguro para realizar el cálculo. No se crea una solicitud ni se contrata una póliza.
confirmation.title: ¿Calcular un capital orientativo?

description: Calculates an indicative life-insurance coverage amount for a resident of Spain with PuntoSeguro's published method: five years of net annual income plus outstanding debts, minus existing life cover, rounded up to the nearest 10,000 EUR. Returns the amount and its breakdown. Informational only; not individualized financial advice, premiums or savings products.

annual_net_income_eur.description: Annual net income to protect for dependants, in euros

existing_life_cover_eur.description: Existing life-insurance cover already in force, in euros

outstanding_debts_eur.description: Outstanding debts, including mortgage balance, in euros

name: calculate_life_insurance_coverage

methodology.const: 5 years of net income + outstanding debts - existing life cover

title: Calculate life-insurance coverage
